summary: Talk of reproducing pictures and a break as people leave.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: ... O.K., will you be back with them the next time? O.K., then we can have a cup of coffee. Let me know the day 'cause I'll take that day off if it isn't on a Sunday.

I'll have to get the government to pay for this to get all of these pictures reproduced. I'll write a letter and have the National Endowment which is paying Jay C. for this to see if we can get all of these pictures reproduced, because this is very valuable.
This is a grand-daughter. She's walking now.
Now we can keep on talking.
